description: This file contains a Java test class named TenantJmsIT which extends TenantApiTests. It is part of the Eclipse Hono project and appears to be an integration test class that tests the Tenant API over JMS for the device registry component. The class uses JUnit 5 with Vertx extension to perform asynchronous testing of tenant-related functionalities via a JMS connection, including setup and cleanup of connections and clients, and several test cases verifying error handling for invalid requests.

classes.name: TenantJmsIT
classes.description: An integration test class for the Tenant API over JMS, extending TenantApiTests, implementing setup and teardown methods and several test cases for error handling.

methods.name: prepareDeviceRegistry

methods.description: Logs the name of each test before execution.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes tenant connections after all tests are run.
